Class AbstractManipulatorImageSource

java.lang.Object
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.source.AbstractImageSource
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.source.AbstractManipulatorImageSource
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageSource, ManipulatorImageSource
Direct Known Subclasses:
FilterImageSource
public abstract class AbstractManipulatorImageSource extends AbstractImageSource implements ManipulatorImageSource
An abstract base class for ManipulatorImageSource implementations to reduce boilerplate. It delegates common methods to the wrapped base source.

    • load

      public void load(URL url)
      Loads the image from URL.

      This operation is not supported for manipulators, as they are designed to wrap an existing ImageSource rather than loading a resource from a URL directly.

      Specified by:
      load in interface ImageSource
      Overrides:
      load in class AbstractImageSource
      Parameters:
      url - The URL to load the image from.
      Throws:
